written_by: Claude, from the clip's own subtitle track and a frame contact sheet, before running the pipeline. Not a trainer's list; test data only.

steps.text: Set the lower container with the tap onto the base.
Take one rubber ring off the ceramic filter.
Insert the ceramic filter through the upper container and fit the rubber ring back on.
Screw the tube onto the filter slowly.
Set the upper container onto the lower container.
Pour water into the upper container.
Put the lid on the filter.
